risk_summary: Enrollment binds a single-use token to the authenticated user, tenant, hardware-backed device key, and fresh MDM attestation before trusted status can be consumed.

controls: single-use token bound to user, tenant, enrollment intent, and expiry
hardware-backed key proof required during token redemption
fresh MDM attestation required before trusted status
re-enrollment of an existing device record requires explicit review
revocation clears certificates, trusted-device cookies, posture cache, and refresh tokens
access consumers re-check current device trust at sensitive boundaries

expected_assessment.review_note: The flow is a safe comparator because trust is single-use, bound to user and device proof, fresh at access time, and revocable across downstream credentials.
